_comment: Example probe file for checks/client_regression.py (CS-3a). Not an approved record: confirm every expectation once on your validated version, remove or fix any probe you cannot confirm, and approve the file with the validation plan. Hook fail-closed and managed-over-user override stay in the manual CS-3 unless you script them for your baseline.

probes.description: IQ-01: the installed client is the candidate version
IQ-03: managed, project and CI configuration unchanged against the approved baseline; version change only to the candidate
OQ-08: the bypass flag is refused (managed permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode = "disable")
command: Reply with the single word OK.
probes.verify: Confirm the observed exit code and message once on the validated version and adjust the expectation before approval.

probes.description: OQ-08: a write outside the workspace fails in the managed sandbox
command: Run exactly this shell command and nothing else: touch {home}/cs3a-sandbox-probe
probes.verify: Needs the managed sandbox of the baseline (sandbox.enabled, sandbox.failIfUnavailable, sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands false).

probes.description: OQ-08: network access to a domain outside the managed allow-list fails
command: Run exactly this shell command and nothing else: curl -sS -m 10 -o {workdir}/cs3a-net-probe https://example.com/
probes.verify: Use a domain that is not on sandbox.network.allowedDomains of your baseline.
